item.title: Head of FCP Operations
item.description:
Banking is changing, and we want to be the ones changing it. Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank founded in 2015, building a bank with AI at its core and making it simpler for people and businesses to manage their money. Today we have offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm, and we’re just getting started.

Every customer who trusts us with their money also trusts us to keep it safe. That’s where FCP Operations comes in. Our four specialist teams, Transaction Monitoring and UAR, Fraud, Sanctions and PEP, and Operational Due Diligence, form the bank’s operational defence against money laundering, fraud, sanctions breaches and third party risk. That covers our own customers as well as the customers of our Banking-as-a-Service partners.

As Head of FCP Operations, you’ll lead four Team Leads directly and more than 40 specialists across those teams. You’ll set the direction, decide where resources go, and be the link between operations and Compliance, AML/MLRO, Risk, Legal, Tech and our BaaS partners. You’ll have short decision paths, so your decisions turn into action fast. The work matters too, because you’ll protect thousands of customers from financial crime across borders. Outside the bank, you’ll work with other banks, Finance Denmark and the Danish Police (NSK). You’ll report to the Director of FCP Opreations.

To be upfront, this isn’t a quiet role. Fraud typologies and sanctions regimes change quickly, often with little notice, and our teams work under time pressure with customers who’ve been affected. If you can stay calm and decide well when things move fast, you’ll fit right in.

What will you do

  • Set the strategy, roadmap and goals for FCP Operations in line with our risk appetite and regulatory requirements, and turn them into clear priorities for each team.

  • Lead, develop and keep your Team Leads, and through them build strong, engaged teams. That covers hiring, performance and growing people’s skills.

  • Own the operational picture: SLAs and KPIs, capacity planning, resource allocation and budget follow-up across monitoring, fraud, sanctions and ODD. You’ll also report on risks, volumes, quality and material incidents to management and relevant forums.

  • Act as the operational anchor when a new fraud wave hits, sanctions lists change or an incident lands, and keep management informed with clear, timely updates.

  • Raise quality and efficiency by making sure case handling is consistent, documented and audit-ready, following up on audit and supervisory findings, and working with Requirements and Tech to automate manual steps and tune rules and models.

What are we looking for in you

  • Experience leading other leaders in an operational environment, ideally in banking, fintech, compliance or financial crime operations.

  • A solid understanding of money laundering, fraud typologies (phishing, smishing, spoofing, investment fraud, money mule networks, CEO fraud) and sanctions risk. You need enough depth to challenge and support specialists in more than one area.

  • Working knowledge of the regulations that shape this space, such as the Danish AML Act, EU sanctions regulation, the Payments Act, PSD2/PSD3, GDPR and DORA. You should also know how production orders, seizure and freezing of funds, and disclosure to authorities work in practice.

  • Hands-on familiarity with transaction monitoring, screening and case management tools. Experience with Nordic payment and identity solutions (MitID, BankID, Swish), card dispute rules (Visa/Mastercard) and how risk is split in a BaaS setup is a strong plus.

  • A clear, steady leadership style. You balance long-term direction with daily operations and explain complex issues simply to management, authorities and partners. You build trust across functions and you’re comfortable challenging and being challenged.

What you get

  • 4 days in the office. We’re a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • A well-equipped workspace. You’ll have a modern computer and a comfortable desk setup. We want you to have the tools you need to do your best work.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We’ve got you covered.

Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we’re up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it’s like to work here .

Depending on the regulations in the country where you will be employed, we will ask to see or obtain information about your criminal record. Please note that our employment is conditional upon you not being registered in RKI (Ribers Kredit Information).

item.title: Procurement Manager
item.description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for over a million registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Procurement Manager you'll join our Finance organization reporting to our Legal Director in Aarhus. You'll build Lunar's procurement function from the ground up and run it: setting the policy and framework for how we buy, leading the procurements and renegotiations that matter, and making sure we get value for what we spend, across IT, services, consultants, goods and leases.

You won't work alone. Procurement sits in Legal, and works daily with experts on GDPR, Finance and Company IT.


Every supplier follow a shared process: you own sourcing, price and negotiation, Third Party Risk Management owns the risk view and sits alongside you rather than inside the deal, Legal shapes the contract, and GDPR checks personal data and other requirements before anything is signed. Most of what Lunar buys is technology, so DORA's requirements are built into every ICT purchase. Finance owns the purchase order flow and cost control with you, and Company IT partners you on software licences.

What will you do?

  • Build the function. Set up the procurement policy, procedures and approval thresholds for all spend, from software and hardware to consultants, marketing, travel and leases, and make sure the business knows them and follows them.

  • Run procurements and negotiations. Lead tenders, vendor selection and negotiations with business owners, from business case to signed contract, together with Legal and Third Party Risk Management.

  • Stop paying for what we do not use. Work with Company IT on licence management and with business owners on renewals, so no contract renews without a decision and we cut what we use too little.

  • Run one process with our control functions. Set up the handover with Third Party Risk Management, the DPO and Legal, so each supplier gets a clear risk classification, a GDPR check and contract requirements before we sign, without slowing the business down.

  • Make cost control data based. Together with Finance, set up the purchase order flow and one overview of contracts and spend, so we know what we have committed, with whom and why, and whether business cases deliver what they promised.

  • Develop Vendor Management. Define our approach to vendor management (what happens after signature), and build recommendations that make sure we get what we pay for and where we have clear vendor termination processes.

  • Move from control to strategy. Over time, build category management and strategic sourcing for our main spend areas, consolidate vendors and negotiate with a multi year view.

What are we looking for in you?

  • 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing or category management, with a large share of it on IT, software and technology spend.

  • Experience from the financial sector, energy, defence or another regulated industry, where procurement has to stand up to audit and regulatory scrutiny.

  • Negotiation results you can point to: contracts renegotiated, vendors consolidated, savings delivered.

  • You have built or matured a procurement process before, including policy, thresholds, approval flows and purchase orders, and you know how to make the business actually use it.

  • Comfortable working with Legal, Data Protection and Finance on the same supplier. You know that a good deal can still fail a GDPR or DORA check, and you plan for it.

  • Strong commercial and contractual understanding. You read a contract and see what it means for price, term, renewal and exit. A background in business, law or supply chain, for example cand.merc. or cand.merc.jur., or equivalent practical experience.

  • A clear writer who is comfortable challenging vendors, business owners and senior stakeholders. Fluent in English.

Bonus if you bring:

  • Working knowledge of DORA or the EBA outsourcing guidelines.

  • Experience with software asset or licence management.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or a similar ERP, or with procurement and spend management tools.

A year from now, Lunar has one procurement process the business knows and uses, a full overview of our contracts and spend, and fewer licences we pay for but do not use.

What you get

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!

item.title: Sales Executive - Moonrise
item.description:
Lunar is changing banking. We’re a Nordic challenger bank, founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm, and we’re building the future of financial services with AI at the core. Over the last decade we’ve developed innovative technology and products for individuals and businesses. Now we’re opening that technology up to fintechs, giving them access to local accounts and payments through modern APIs. That’s Moonrise by Lunar.

Moonrise serves regulated financial enterprises, from payment and e-money institutions to banks, that want to enter or grow in the Nordics. Our clients include Currency Cloud, Visa Direct, Wise, Trustly and many more of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Sales Executive to help us win the next wave of them.

This isn’t a typical sales role. You’ll join the early days of our Banking Services venture, with clear market fit, strong backing from our leadership, and plenty of room to shape how we work. You’ll report to the General Manager of Moonrise.

What will you do

  • Own your segment end to end, from market research and outbound prospecting through to a signed contract, building relationships with senior decision makers at international payment and fintech companies.

  • Fill your own pipeline through outbound outreach, event networking (such as Pay360 in London and Money20/20) and by working the inbound leads that come in.

  • Manage long sales cycles of 6 to 12 months on deals typically worth between 1 and 10 million DKK, working closely with our sales engineer on technical flows and with legal on contract negotiations.

  • Guide new clients through our nine-week financial crime and onboarding process with the FCP team, then hand over to Partner Success to get them live.

  • Work toward quarterly targets, both as an individual and as part of the Moonrise team.

What are we looking for in you

  • At least 5 years’ experience as an Account Executive or in a similar quota-carrying sales role within payments, fintech or banking, ideally with a payments or fintech company.

  • A proven track record of selling complex technical solutions to large clients, managing deal cycles from prospect to close. API and payment infrastructure knowledge is a strong advantage.

  • A hunter mindset: you’re energized by closing deals and hitting high targets, and you’re comfortable handling pressure.

  • Gravitas with senior stakeholders such as CPOs and CEOs, and the habit of researching a company’s business model, financials and leadership before every meeting.

  • A proactive, people-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-moving start-up environment, is comfortable navigating new territory, and has professional working proficiency in English.

Why join Moonrise

This role is more than just a job, it’s an adventure! You’ll be joining at an early stage, helping shape the future of Moonrise. We’re offering an unmatched opportunity to navigate new territory, take ownership and make a real impact.

What you get

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • A well-equipped workspace. You’ll have a modern computer and a comfortable desk setup. We want you to have the tools you need to do your best work.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

item.title: Senior Security Engineer
item.description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for a million of registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will be part of Squad Gravity, our dedicated security team based in Aarhus. You will own and drive security across a broad surface; including cloud and endpoint protection, enabling secure use of AI solutions, incident response, compliance, and detection engineering. You won't just advise from the sidelines. You will be hands-on, building the defences, responding to real threats, and shaping the security posture of a Nordic fintech going to the moon. Squad Gravity is part of the innovation, not the typical "department of no" that you see in other organisations. Our mission statement is “Building Trust at Scale through Frictionless Security”. As such, your goal is to enable secure innovation and fast pace with smart use of AI and modern cloud technology.

What will you do?

Squad Gravity is responsible for security operations, compliance, and resilience at Lunar. The scope is wide, and you will contribute across several areas:

  • Cloud, Infrastructure & CI/CD: Engineer and harden security across AWS, Kubernetes and Github Actions.

  • AI & Automation: Help us understand and address the security implications and explore how AI can make our own security work smarter.

  • Security Findings & Remediation: Assess and remediate security findings across AWS, Kubernetes, and employee endpoints - spanning critical vulnerabilities such as React2Shell to RBAC privilege escalation vulnerabilities.

  • Compliance & Policy: Contribute to gap analysis of regulation or compliance frameworks such as DORA, GDPR, AI Act, ISO27001 and similar.

  • Penetration Testing: Coordinate external penetration tests, communicate findings to stakeholders, and drive remediation of results.

Who are you?

You are someone who thrives in a role where no two weeks look the same. You are equally comfortable digging into a Kubernetes RBAC vulnerability as you are drafting an encryption policy or investigating a phishing campaign. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and know when to go deep versus when to move fast.

We know this is a broad role and we don't expect you to be an expert in everything from day one. What matters is that you are strong in some of these areas and genuinely curious to grow in the others. As such, if you are a strong DevSecOps/SRE/Platform Engineer profile, with an interest in Security and Security Engineering, don't hesitate to apply.

We are looking for people with the following experience:

  • Cloud Engineering and Security: Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes. You should be comfortable using technologies like Terraform for AWS and GitOps for Kubernetes. Furthermore, you should be well-versed in designing secure cloud-native applications using modern best practices.

  • AI Readiness: You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you have experience with Claude Code and working with agentic solutions. You understand how these AI tools work and how they change the security landscape.

  • Identity & Access Management: Experience with SAML, OIDC and similar protocols and technologies in a corporate environment. Experience with RBAC, least privilege access models, and identity management in cloud environments.

  • Communication & Soft Skills: You can explain security concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. You have strong soft skills and know how to influence others effectively without being seen as the typical "security gatekeeper".

  • Experience: 3+ years in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a similar role, ideally in a tech-driven or regulated environment.

What you get.

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • A well-equipped workspace. You’ll have a modern computer and a comfortable desk setup. We want you to have the tools you need to do your best work.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

What will you do?

  • Own the Cards and Top-ups product end to end. Set a customer-centred strategy, own the roadmap, and lead execution and performance across our Nordic markets, agreeing success metrics before work starts and iterating on what customers actually use.

  • Own the economics. Be accountable for customer impact, cost to serve, operational load and risk, and know the cost per active card and which levers move it.

  • Run the partner ecosystem. Build and manage relationships with card schemes, processors, wallets, card manufacturing and fulfilment, and fraud and dispute tooling. Set SLAs, run business reviews, and keep every feature viable in every Nordic market alongside commercial, risk and compliance.

item.title: Senior Financial Controller
item.description:
Banking is changing, and we're building the bank that's driving that change. Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank, founded in Aarhus in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, and Stockholm. item.title: Treasury Manager
item.description:
Banking is changing, and we’re building the bank that’s driving that change. Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank, founded in Aarhus in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm. We’re putting AI at the core of how we build and run the bank, but managing the money behind it still takes sound judgement. That’s where Treasury comes in.

As our new Treasury Manager, you’ll join the Treasury team in Aarhus and report to our Head of Treasury. Treasury manages Lunar’s liquidity, interest rate risk and bond portfolio, and makes sure the bank always has the funding, buffers and hedges it needs to stay safe and keep growing.

Lunar is just over ten years old, and our Treasury function is still being built. In most banks, you’d join a team where the setup is already in place. Here, you’ll help shape it. As the bank grows, we’re looking into repo activity, developing the composition of our bond portfolio, exploring a trading book and broadening our mandates. If you like to question how things are done, drive projects and see your ideas put into practice, you’ll get the chance to do that here.

What will you do?

  • Take part in daily Treasury operations, from liquidity management to FX risk hedging. A good share of the work is routine and operational, and we won’t pretend otherwise. Doing it well every day is what keeps the bank safe, and it’s how you’ll learn the workflows inside out.

  • Monitor key ratios like LCR and NSFR, track interest rate risk in the banking book and recommend hedges when they’re needed.

  • Help build the market analysis tools that sharpen Treasury’s view of the world, and use them to make better decisions, manage risk with confidence and grow revenue for the bank.

  • Manage relationships with banks and counterparties for money market transactions and repos. That includes challenging current scopes and credit limits, and onboarding new counterparties.

  • Spot opportunities to shape the future of Treasury and take projects from first idea to finished result. You’ll also be Treasury’s voice in cross-functional projects, making sure our perspective helps steer the bank’s most important decisions.

  • Keep Treasury’s processes, controls and documentation up to date and audit-ready.

What are we looking for in you?

  • A Master’s degree in Economics, Finance or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Up to 3 years of experience in banking or treasury, with a solid understanding of liquidity management, interest rate risk, LCR, NSFR and CRR.

  • A detail-oriented approach and a strong controls mindset. You notice when the numbers don’t add up, and you care about getting them right.

  • Clear communication. You work well with Risk, Finance, Compliance and the business, and you explain your analysis and recommendations in a way people act on.

  • Drive and curiosity. You’d rather help build something than inherit a finished setup, you like digging into how things really work, and you give the routine parts of the job the same energy as the analytical ones.

  • It’s a plus if you have hands-on experience with money markets, repos, bond portfolios or FX hedging, have worked with a treasury system like FIS Quantum, or have been part of system, data or policy projects. Advanced Excel will help you every day, and Python is a bonus.

  • You've managed ICT vendors after the signature, including SLAs, reviews, reassessment and exit planning for critical vendors.

  • Partner with teams across the organization to help them build and integrate new solutions, working across domains to solve data aggregation and integration challenges, and drive projects with minimal support.

  • Work with a high degree of autonomy in an agile environment, and evaluate team processes to identify and implement high-impact improvements.

What are we looking for in you?

  • Minimum of 3 years of backend experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex systems at scale.

  • Expertise in event-driven architecture and distributed systems, balancing trade-offs to ensure system reliability and performance.

  • Experience with cloud technologies.

  • Experience with Go is a significant advantage.

  • A strong interest in AI and familiarity with solutions like OpenAI.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and domains.

What you get.

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

item.title: Engineering Manager
item.description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for millions of people across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new Engineering Manager you'll join the Platform Engineering team based in Aarhus, reporting to Rolf Njor Jensen, VP of Technology, working to shape how Lunar builds, and the systems we build with.

You'll lead two squads, nine engineers, mostly senior. One owns our application platform for mobile and web, including authorization. The other owns our builder-productivity platform, now focused on getting the whole company to AI-native development. Both squads serve other engineers, and their value shows up in the leverage they give everyone else.

What will you do?

  • Lead two squads of senior engineers. Set direction, clear blockers, and give strong ICs room to do their best work. Match your leadership style to the person. Help them grow.

  • Own platform outcomes across both squads: reliability, paved roads, productivity, quality, adoption. Hold internal teams to the same bar as any customer.

  • Drive Lunar's shift to AI-native development. Take us from ad-hoc experiments to embedded practice, in the direction the industry calls the software factory. Handle the culture, tech, people, process, and regulatory sides (DORA and beyond).

  • Help decide where the builder-productivity platform goes next, working closely with whoever defines what gets built and why.

  • Partner with Product and other teams so technical priorities map straight to what customers need. Communicate often, set expectations early.

What are we looking for in you?

  • 3-4 years leading engineering teams. You've helped senior ICs and tech leads set their own direction instead of directing from above. You've hired, coached, and managed performance.

  • Platform engineering experience. You build for internal customers, think in leverage and adoption, and know the trade-offs of systems other teams rely on.

  • Solid infrastructure chops. You know how systems get built, hosted, and scaled, and what pushes hosting and compute costs up or down.

  • Real, hands-on experience with agentic coding tools, and genuine curiosity about where this goes next.

  • A product instinct. You can say what a platform should do and why, set direction when things shift, and bring your team with you.

Benefits and perks

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • A well-equipped workspace. You’ll have a modern computer and a comfortable desk setup. We want you to have the tools you need to do your best work.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.

Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we're up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it's like to work here.
